digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command grammar
propositions: Advanced command handlers contain duplicate inline argparse construction and manual dispatch logic that must be extracted into reusable S2a parser factories
Parser factories must construct ArgumentParser instances without importing optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing)
ParseError raised by RebarArgumentParser.error() must be caught and converted to identical exit code 2 and stderr output where handlers currently catch SystemExit
Commands with custom presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must preserve byte-identical help output after migration
All advanced routes must have registered factory references and be deterministically generation-ready without executing handlers or importing heavy dependencies
